metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: Maximum Safeguard F case (all three triggers met) yet zero secession / zero violence under high P1; porosity has no hard ceiling; Mod10 backstops (monarchy, caretaker convention, EU, Brussels).
metadata.notes: Run4 Case 17 -- the limit test. WGI cited on World Bank estimate scale (-2.5 to +2.5). UK RoL 1.27 and Belgium RoL 1.28 are statistically indistinguishable (Mod4 declines to rank them). Most pillar values ordinal/estimated, not cardinal.

pre_event.event_description: Belgium's six-government federal architecture under extreme linguistic/regional fragmentation pressure -- the framework's high-porosity limit test.

context.backstop_details: Mod10 backstops: the monarchy (the King's appointment of informateurs/formateurs structures every formation), the caretaker-government convention (prior coalition stays in office, preventing a vacuum), the EU framework, and Brussels as a shared capital neither region can exclusively claim.

Belgium.notes: Belgium WGI estimate scale: RoL ~1.28 (top tier; indistinguishable from UK 1.27). All three Safeguard F triggers met: (1) separatist/nationalist vote >25% in Flanders -- N-VA 24.5% + Vlaams Belang 22.8% = ~47% (2024); (2) executive repeatedly suspended -- 541 days in 2010-11 and 652 days in 2019-20 (both world records per the Brussels Times), still forming after the June 2024 election at source-reporting time; (3) regional divergence >30% -- Flemish EUR47,300 PPS vs Walloon EUR33,400 PPS (>40% gap; Wallonia ~72% of the Belgian average). 'executive_collapses'=3 recorded record-length formations (2010-11, 2019-20, 2024).

Belgium.outcome_summary: Prediction confirmed at the limit: with high P1 and open porosity channels, the state persists in managed tension. Zero secession and zero political violence despite all three Safeguard F triggers, sustained by extreme Tier 3 architecture (six governments, linguistic parity, alarm-bell procedure, concurrent majorities) and Mod10 backstops. Belgium demonstrates porosity has no hard ceiling under high P1.

analysis.overall_assessment: Confirmed at the limit: Belgium is the extreme porosity case -- all three Safeguard F triggers met, yet zero secession and zero political violence. With high P1 and open porosity channels backed by hard backstops, the state persists indefinitely in managed tension.
safeguards_triggered: F (all three triggers: separatist vote ~47%, record executive formations, regional divergence >40%)
I (porosity-with-backstop, Mod10: monarchy + caretaker convention + EU + Brussels)
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Porosity has no hard ceiling under high P1: even with every Safeguard F trigger maxed out, a state persists indefinitely when open porosity channels are caught by hard backstops.
proposed_framework_modifications: Promote candidate Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop) to a working safeguard -- Belgium is the strongest single demonstration.
Mod4: do not rank statistically indistinguishable P1 pairs (UK RoL 1.27 vs Belgium RoL 1.28).
analysis.baseline_impact: Promoting Safeguard I to a working safeguard needs the 20-case baseline check.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
